name: Izuki Fueko
source:
A serious, strong-willed girl who attends a different elite prep school than Shinobu and the others. She has a kind of cleanliness obsession and can’t stop herself from pointing out other people’s mistakes. Despite that, she’s deeply lonely at heart and hates being on her own. Emotionally fragile, she also has a self-sacrificing streak. She’s dismissive of anything flashy and is almost pathologically frightened by disorder, broken rules, or rough, aggressive behavior.

[From the [https://web.archive.org/web/20240521122532/https://xuse.co.jp/product/053_farthest2015/pageCharacter.html]official site[/url].]
